activation_disposition.reason: No rights-cleared donor-level MASLD spatial dataset currently satisfies the donor-join, graph, prior-asset, split, and output-file record requirements.

architecture_contract.native_observation: one spatially located cell or spot
architecture_contract.required_graph: A symmetric binary spatial adjacency supplied in AnnData obsp under the selected adjacency key.
architecture_contract.prior_mechanism: Masked gene-program encoder and decoder links derived from ligand-receptor, transcription-factor-target, and optional metabolite-related prior programs.
architecture_contract.warning: Successful ingestion of H&E, CODEX, or MALDI-derived features through a generic container would not make those assays native NicheCompass observations. Any such extension is a separately specified model.

implementation.publication_title: Quantitative characterization of cell niches in spatially resolved omics data

checkpoint_contract.rule: A future fold-specific model is a new checkpoint identity. Record training donors, graph and prior hashes, exact source and environment, state-dict manifest, seed, and artifact SHA-256 separately for every fold and seed.

input_contract.gene_order: Freeze a training-derived ordered feature roster. A held donor is aligned to that roster; absent genes are masked or handled by a predeclared native rule, never silently interpreted as measured zeros.
input_contract.raw_counts: Retain assay-native count semantics. Normalization, highly variable feature selection, program filtering, and scaling are fitted inside training donors only.
input_contract.paired_RNA_ATAC: Allowed only when RNA and ATAC are observed on the same cell or nucleus. Same-donor, same-section, adjacent-section, or different-aliquot measurements are not substituted as paired observations.
input_contract.sample_covariates: Any categorical sample or batch embedding and the policy for an unseen held donor must be frozen before evaluation.
input_contract.spatial_coordinates: Coordinates must carry explicit section, participant, units, scale, and registration provenance. Pixel and micron coordinates are not mixed without a frozen transform.

spatial_graph_contract.construction: Build each graph independently within an authoritative participant and section boundary, then combine as a block-diagonal graph. Never construct neighbors after pooling raw coordinates from multiple donors, slides, arrays, or fields of view.
spatial_graph_contract.required_lock: Freeze implementation revision, coordinate system, metric, neighbor or radius rule, physical scale, boundary masks, symmetrization, self-loop policy, isolated-node policy, and graph edge-list SHA-256.
spatial_graph_contract.vu2025_rule: Do not construct a graph on a VLP capture array until every barcode or tissue island has an authoritative biopsy and participant assignment. Four to five participants share each technical array.
spatial_graph_contract.held_donor_rule: A held donor may use its own unlabeled coordinates to form a within-donor query graph under the frozen rule. Its labels, outcomes, clusters, or manually outcome-guided boundaries may not affect graph construction.

held_donor_capability.frozen_inductive_lane: Potentially supported: apply frozen model weights, training-derived gene and program rosters, and a fixed covariate policy to a new donor's within-donor graph. This capability is not yet verified on a fixed fixture.
held_donor_capability.query_adaptive_lane: Native reference mapping or fine-tuning that adds or learns query sample covariates uses held-donor features and is transductive or query-adaptive. It must be reported separately and cannot be called zero-shot.
held_donor_capability.selection_firewall: Clustering, prototype count, resolution, early stopping, graph hyperparameters, program pruning, and label mapping are selected using development donors only.
held_donor_capability.unseen_sample_covariate: UNRESOLVED; a neutral or reference-coded policy must be prespecified for the frozen lane rather than creating a learned embedding from evaluator labels.

prior_asset_contract.dynamic_retrieval: The pinned implementation can retrieve resources such as NicheNet, OmniPath, and CollecTRI. Network access and mutable latest resources are forbidden in benchmark runs.
prior_asset_contract.required_lock: Vendor only rights-cleared versions into a project-controlled offline bundle; record source URL, version or release date, organism, identifier authority, license, row-level provenance, canonical serialization, and SHA-256.
prior_asset_contract.bundled_or_referenced_assets: Mouse GENCODE vM25, human-mouse ortholog, and metabolite enzyme or sensor tables require independent applicability and terms review before use in a human MASLD model.
prior_asset_contract.hotspot_firewall: The frozen 117 Atlas Hotspot programs are read-only post hoc projections. They cannot be NicheCompass training programs, optimized features, selection endpoints, or hyperparameter targets.

safe_loading_contract.native_behavior: The pinned save path writes model_params.pt, attr.pkl, and var_names.csv; the load path uses torch.load and pickle.load and warns rather than fails on a variable-name mismatch.
safe_loading_contract.risk: Pickle and unrestricted torch deserialization are unsafe for untrusted artifacts, and warning-only gene-order handling is inadequate for a frozen benchmark.
safe_loading_contract.required_project_path: Accept only project-produced trusted fold artifacts. Prefer a tensor-only state dictionary or safetensors plus schema-validated JSON metadata; require exact keys, shapes, dtypes, finite values, gene order, program order, and adjacency contract. No upstream pickled model object is admitted.
safe_loading_contract.network: No model, prior, or data retrieval is allowed during load or inference.

runtime_contract.required_probe: After activation and campaign approval only: isolated L40S import, graph construction fixture, forward, backward, checkpoint resume, deterministic seed, cell-order permutation, block-diagonal graph, held-donor encode, no-network, and cross-device numeric-tolerance probes through SLURM.

terms_and_release_contract.code: BSD-3-Clause at the pinned source revision.
terms_and_release_contract.local_weights: A locally trained state dictionary may be released only if every training dataset and prior asset permits model training and derivative-weight redistribution; BSD source terms alone do not resolve those upstream rights.
terms_and_release_contract.open_champion: ineligible while no eligible donor-level spatial source, split, prior bundle, trained checkpoint, and weight-redistribution receipt exist

source_evidence: The Nature Genetics article, official GitHub release and raw source at the pinned revision, and official PyPI metadata were inspected online on 2026-08-22. No package, checkpoint, prior bundle, or dataset was downloaded, installed, or executed.
